jobs.description:
We are regularly looking for enthusiastic logistics staff who are eager to roll up their sleeves and get to work. In this role, you may be assigned to various departments, and your responsibilities will include receiving, inspecting, and preparing products for shipment. Outbound Operations: What does your workday look like as an order picker or packer? You ensure that orders are prepared for shipment. As an order picker, you do this by filling boxes with the correct products. These boxes come your way on a conveyor belt. Using a handheld scanner, you scan the pick list and fill the box with the correct products from inventory. As a packer, you’re responsible for getting the order ready for shipment; you fill the box and attach a shipping label to it. Then you place the box back on the conveyor belt and move on to the next one! Inbound Duties As an Inbound Logistics Associate, you’ll work in the inbound departments where all medical supplies arrive. After the daily kick-off meeting with your team, the workday begins, and your tasks will include sorting incoming goods, recording the goods in the system, and moving them to the correct location in the warehouse. This is a full-time position. Workdays are Monday through Friday, and you’ll work two shifts. The work hours are from 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. and from 2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. What skills do you have? You are comfortable working with computers and/or handheld scanners and are able to quickly master new systems; You have good spatial awareness and can quickly pick orders according to instructions. You are able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG); Sufficient command of spoken and written English due to safety instructions and communication on the work floor; Available full-time and willing to work extra hours

when needed. In short, are you the logistics employee who enjoys getting hands-on in the warehouse, with an eye for quality and safety? Then you’re a perfect fit for this position! You have own accommodation in Kerkrade area What do you get in return? Full-time position, 40 hours per week; Gross hourly wage between €15.25 and €15.80 (including a 7.5% shift differential); Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer (unlimited kilometers); A taxi service is available; Company fitness options (individual workouts and group classes); Excellent opportunities for career growth and development; Performance-based annual pay raise; Pension plan through Wiertz starting from the first week of employment; 13th month bonus. Boston Scientific, a company that has been a global leader in medical technology for more than 35 years. Everyone here works together toward a single goal: to improve lives by addressing the most significant health challenges. We do this through innovative products, a strong culture of collaboration, and a deep passion for improving people’s lives.

As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Testing and releasing equipment after repairs. Carrying out inspections and condition monitoring to identify wear, leaks, unusual noises, and performance issues. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Experience in industrial maintenance within a production or manufacturing environment. Knowledge of mechanical drives, bearings,

chains, gears, pneumatics, and basic hydraulics. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them. Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage but not required. Hier kom je te werken As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring our production and packaging lines operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. You will carry out preventive maintenance, resolve mechanical breakdowns, and contribute to continuous improvements while maintaining the highest food safety and hygiene standards.
